statement: Find a source-bound witness moduli object/correspondence whose projection to the fixed Hodge branch is not merely the fixed-component fibre product and prove that its tangent image contains the required total-class Hodge tangent directions, with exact rational coefficient/category semantics.
difference_witness_required: identify what geometric datum varies that cannot be represented as independent fixed component lifts sharing a base tangent
show why the new object's projection can have tangent image strictly larger than the fixed-component intersection without assuming surjectivity
bind the new object's cycle class to the same rational total class and Hodge branch
separate first-order reachability from higher Artin lifting and algebraization
priority_fibres: source-specific flag-Hilbert/incidence geometries with independent dimension/smoothness control
algebraic correspondences that transport an algebraic total witness with Chow-authority source binding
changing-decomposition cycle families only after a precise representable local category is frozen
